title: Johnsoncab Electricals IPO Details
intro:
Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is a book build issue of ₹56.02 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 28.01 lakh shares of ₹56.02 crore.

Johnsoncab Electricals IPO bidding opened for subscription on Oct 30, 2026 and will close on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for the Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 4, 2026. Johnsoncab Electricals IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 6, 2026.

Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is set issue price band at ₹190 to ₹200 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,40,000 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,60,000.

ISK Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company are Isk Equities Private Ltd. , Sunflower Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Johnsoncab Electricals IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated on November 12, 2020, Johnsoncab Electricals Limited originated as a partnership firm named M/s. Johnson Cables in February 2012. It is engaged in the manufacturing of low-voltage wires and cables rated up to 1.1 kV and markets its products under the brand name “JOHNSON CABLES”, catering to power infrastructure, renewable energy, railways and industrial applications.The Company’s product portfolio includes control cables, power cables, industrial single-core and multicore cables, house and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables and submersible flat cables. Its products are designed for applications across power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, industrial operations and allied sectors. The Company holds ISO and BIS certifications to support product quality and compliance with applicable standards.

Johnsoncab Electricals operates two manufacturing units in Mehsana, Gujarat, with a combined annual installed manufacturing capacity of 79,950 kilometres as of Fiscal 2026. Its facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging. The Company has upgraded its manufacturing infrastructure with automatic and semi-automatic machinery to improve production capabilities and cater to varied product specifications.

The Company serves both government entities and private-sector customers through direct orders, tender participation and vendor approval processes. Revenue from operations increased from ₹88.34 crore in Fiscal 2024 to ₹210.47 crore in Fiscal 2026. For the five months ended August 31, 2026, the Company reported revenue from operations of ₹113.04 crore, EBITDA of ₹15.32 crore and profit after tax of ₹8.63 crore.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 193 employees across production, operations, finance, human resources, quality assurance, sales and marketing, supply chain, logistics and information technology.

Its products are designed for applications across power transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, industrial operations and allied sectors. The Company holds ISO and BIS certifications to support product quality and compliance with applicable standards.

Johnsoncab Electricals operates two manufacturing units in Mehsana, Gujarat, with a combined annual installed manufacturing capacity of 79,950 kilometres as of Fiscal 2026. Its facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging. The Company has upgraded its manufacturing infrastructure with automatic and semi-automatic machinery to improve production capabilities and cater to varied product specifications.

The Company serves both government entities and private-sector customers through direct orders, tender participation and vendor approval processes. Revenue from operations increased from ₹88.34 crore in Fiscal 2024 to ₹210.47 crore in Fiscal 2026. For the five months ended August 31, 2026, the Company reported revenue from operations of ₹113.04 crore, EBITDA of ₹15.32 crore and profit after tax of ₹8.63 crore.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 193 employees across production, operations, finance, human resources, quality assurance, sales and marketing, supply chain, logistics and information technology.

faqs.question: How to apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Johnsoncab Electricals IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Johnsoncab Electricals IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Johnsoncab Electricals IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.answer: You can apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
